### ˚˖𓍢ִ໋❀How to install:
      ✿. Download the .zip
  
      ✿. Locate your game folder
  
      ✿. Put the resource pack on the resourcepacks folder
  
      ✿. Enable ingame and set your language to spanish
  
      ✿. Enjoy!
 

![divider](https://64.media.tumblr.com/dbfc35437f82da5edaf3c1290849316d/6aab50577174cffa-ba/s2048x3072/28037e1cc614b0f3d0b9675842c2043e5b79b456.gifv)

This project is independent and not merged with other translation packs because
- Projects are unrelated to each other
- Other translations  exist, by being a separate project you can choose specific translations over others, some players might prefer one or the other, this way you can mix.
- The translations are made for specific versions of mods and versions of Minecraft that can be different from others

You can use this project on any modpack, no need to ask ❤️ 

Disclaimer: No AI was used and never will be used for my translations, because AI doesnt have context on mods.
